title: Roof venting above spray foam insulation
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: A new triplex is proposed with half-pound spray foam between roof joists, applied directly to the underside of roof sheathing, without a venting space.

The appellant said building-science documentation supported the view that the assembly would be airtight; the building official said evidence was insufficient to show air leakage and condensation would be prevented.
The dispute concerns Article 9.19.1.1 and the phrase allowing omission of venting where it can be shown unnecessary.
